title: Negative scenario — a ROLLBACK that re-creates a function but not its prior body
description: Harness self-proof for restore-in-place rollbacks. Migration 45 replaces fn_audit_organisation_change() and its rollback is supposed to put the previous body back; name and signature never change, so a snapshot recording only those measured 53 -> 53 -> 53 objects and proved nothing. Here stage 92 establishes the prior definition (not rolled back, so it is the baseline), stage 93 replaces it in place, and 93's rollback re-creates the function with a third, wrong body. Every statement exits 0 and the object exists before and after with identical name and arguments. The definition digest must fail the run with the rollback exit code (30). Registered as expect-failure so dropping the digest turns CI red.
